criterion: Every member can upload a receipt (web or photo) and enter supplier, amount and date by hand; the file goes through document storage

Match passes give 0.98 (reference), 0.92 (amount plus giro), 0.85 (amount within credit period), 0.70 (amount within 5 kr plus supplier name in bank text); nothing below 0.70 is suggested, each suggestion shows its reason and confidence
Suggestions are never booked silently: confirm, reject and correct each take one action and need bookkeeping.manage; sums on both sides must not exceed the amounts, so split matches work
A correction is remembered for the same supplier, and a switch turns suggestions off for the organisation
A list of unmatched transactions is available
Account suggestion for a receipt from what the organisation booked for the same supplier before
Email inbox: one address per organisation with a random code on one IMAP mailbox; mail with an unknown code is dropped; attachments go to document storage as received
The web has a receipts page: upload, edit fields, suggestions with accept/reject/correct, unmatched transactions, the switch; screenshots at 390 and 1280 px in the PR
